name: After § 6
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Displaced Workers following an application from Finland – EGF/2026/004 FI/Etelä-Suomi and Helsinki-Uusimaa paper
part_text: 6a. Calls on the Commission and the Finnish authorities to continuously reassess the actual number of beneficiaries requiring support, to reimburse only expenditure actually incurred for eligible and verifiable measures, to prevent any double financing and to return all unused appropriations to the Union budget; requests detailed information on the costs, selection procedure and measurable employment outcomes of the AI-based pilot project, the pay subsidies and the allowances financed under the proposed measures;
